newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 17.6 bln levs 3-, 6-, 12-mth T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 17.6 bln levs 3-, 6-, 12-mth T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold three issues of floater coupon T-bills with maturities of three, six and 12 months, yielding 26.14, 52.39 and 108.06 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 21.084 billion levs worth of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for a total of 17.551 billion levs of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance for Monday's auctions.
The coupons for the issues were set equal to the central bank's main interest rate, now set at 8.03 percent monthly or 96.36 percent annually.

A nine-month floater coupon T-bill issue offered under the same conditions was not sold after the ministry approved none of the 3,000 billion lev worth of bids at an average price of 88 percent of par.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 9,066 million levs 9,010 million levs
Bids approved 8,743 million levs 8,800 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 26.14 pct 52.39 pct
Bids received 3,000 million levs 3,008 million levs
